audit.baseRationale: Most advanced shared architecture; 127 commits past main; strict superset of 4 of 5 other branches; the uncommitted working tree sits directly on it and is byte-identical to the assets 51-100 session snapshot.

sources.disposition: INTEGRATED verbatim, split into 15 workstream commits

commits.subject: build(course): make this branch stand alone, and let QA target its own server
commits.rejectReason: Self-labelled BRIDGE scaffolding whose stated exit condition ('drop when clubhouse.js is merged from the concurrent checkout workstream') is already met. Function bodies byte-identical to the working tree apart from comments. Applying would emit a duplicate export of pointInsideClubhouseInterior - an ESM SyntaxError. git apply --check fails.
commits.acceptReason: Genuine fix: replaces two hardcoded port literals with process.env.QA_BASE_URL fallback, matching run-playwright.cjs and serve.cjs. Runner honoured the env var while the script ignored it, so non-default runs drove the wrong tree.

commits.subject: perf(course-editor): terrain strokes go from 5 FPS to 87 FPS
commits.resolution: Incoming is a strict superset. Base scoped only the position write loop and left three unscoped 346,801-vertex passes per tick (computeVertexNormals, Y-scale loop, computeBoundingSphere).

commits.subject: perf(course-editor): scope the terrain rebuild for stamps and feature edits too
commits.risk: HIGHEST - deletes a guard the base deliberately added. Base refused to scope whenever relief was invalidated; incoming honours terrainRect always. Verified bit-exact by probe: 0 differing of 1,040,403 vertex components.

commits.subject: perf(course-editor): upload only the edited span of the terrain buffers
commits.note: Unsafe without windowed normals - partial upload would leave stale GPU normals if all normals were recomputed.

commits.subject: perf(course-editor): undo and redo refresh only the op they reverted
commits.note: Dead code without 2588a0a - fullRefresh passes relief:true, which the base's guard would have discarded. Measured live: undoRefresh 1145.1ms -> undoRefreshScoped 30.1ms.

commits.subject: fix(course): the property stops reading as a rectangle on the landscape
commits.resolution: Different root causes. Base geometry is C1-continuous and resolves the straddling quad 1.65x finer; incoming is only C0 with a slope kink of -edgeH/260 at the property line. But base only narrows the tonal step to ~1.7x and it varies with luma; incoming assigns the terrain OUT branch verbatim for a flat 1.00x. Took geometry from base, colour from incoming.

commits.subject: fix(course): every pond gets its real shoreline, not a bounding-box disc
commits.resolution: Merged both - they fix opposite halves. Incoming ungates outlinedWaters and matches the tightest bbox; the base's cellComponentOutline raster tracer survives as the FALLBACK covering vec streams and legacy grid courses. CircleGeometry now sits behind the tracer and is unreachable.

commits.subject: fix(course-editor): the camera stops fighting the player and the keyboard
commits.note: Touches a different keydown listener than the working tree's rewrite. Working tree modifies the switch-hotkey listener; this modifies the held-key listener, which is unguarded inside the editor so typing a course name panned the map.
